purpose: Replace the active legacy slope-only honeycomb phase-map presentation with an explicit decodable side, undecodable side, discrete lower-boundary uncertainty band, and no-two-sided-bracket region.

display_semantics.decodable: green cells at or below the lower decodable endpoint of a valid row bracket; where no bracket exists, only posterior-stable absolute floor anchors are green
display_semantics.undecodable: red cells at or above the upper undecodable endpoint of a valid row bracket; where no bracket exists, only posterior-stable absolute saturation anchors are red
display_semantics.boundary: amber cells strictly between the two observed endpoints of a valid discrete lower-boundary bracket
display_semantics.unclassified: neutral cells on rows without a valid two-sided bracket and without an absolute-LER anchor
display_semantics.absolute_anchor_outline: dark cell outline denotes a Jeffreys/uniform-prior-stable absolute floor or saturation anchor

presentation_replacement.reason: Historical slope-only outputs remain provenance downloads, but they must no longer appear as active report or Lab-page phase diagrams.

acceptance: The preflight recomputes an exhaustive 231-cell display classification from the hash-frozen Phase B11 result without rendering.
The rendered primary panel contains no crosses, point-crossing counts, or continuous p_c interpolation.
Green, amber, red, and neutral layers have direct physical labels; dark outlines are cell-level absolute-LER anchors rather than point annotations.
Visual inspection confirms legible axes, legend, boundary uncertainty, and finite-window claim boundary.
REPORT.md embeds the new figure and removes the active legacy Phase B9 embed; Lab-page legacy B5-B9 phase figures are demoted from page presentation.
Dashboard end-to-end tests verify that the new figure is visible from the Lab 003 result page.
stop_rule: This transition stops after registration, implementation, tests, and preflight. Do not render, edit report presentation, demote legacy figures, or select samples in the same tick.
claim_boundary: Operational finite-window, finite-grid phase-side and discrete lower-boundary-bracket presentation only; no continuous p_c interpolation, asymptotic threshold, or thermodynamic phase claim.
